title: German Financial Firm Reportedly Gave Inadequate Explanations for Automated Credit Card Denials
summary: Hamburg's data protection regulator reportedly found that an unnamed financial firm in Germany automatically rejected several credit card applications from people with good credit. The firm's explanations were reportedly too general for applicants to understand why they were denied, making the decisions harder to challenge. The firm accepted a €492,000 fine.
